summary: Qzone is reachable and authorized from this client, over two independent transports (trpc-over-HTTP and the old CGI). The 2026-11-18 'not authorized' finding was an artefact of a probe that omitted the x-oidb header: the trpc gateway is addressed by that header, so without it there was no command to authorize.

superseded_finding.conclusion: every RPC -> retcode 4001 'not authorized', including with no cookie; endpoint refuses before checking credentials
superseded_finding.why_it_was_wrong: The empty-cookie control was valid but measured the wrong thing. The probe sent Content-Type / Origin / Referer / User-Agent / Cookie and no x-oidb, so the gateway had no uint32_command to route. 4001 answered 'which command is this?', not 'are you allowed?'.

EntranceCtrl_BatchEntranceWhitelist_0x97.note: per-entrance switches; this account has public_qzone_* all false

FeedsReader_GetFriendFeeds_0x97e5_0.note: body {} accepted; returns feeds[] of cell_* objects plus a pagination attach_info

FeedsReader_GetShuoshuoList_0x9a97_1.note: this account's own posts plus attach_info

FeedsReader_GetComment_0x9bfd_1.note: reachable; cell_comment was null for the feed tested, so the body shape is unconfirmed

FeedsReader_GetPublicRecomFeeds_0x9a38_0.note: route works but the account is not in the public-qzone (空友爱看) whitelist, matching its false entrance switches

InteractionWriter_DeleteComment_0x9989_0.note: aimed at a synthetic comment id, so nothing could be deleted. The point is the answer: not 4001, so the path is routed and authorized and the failure is the bogus target.

GET_/proxy/domain/base.qzone.qq.com/cgi-.note: JSONP-wrapped (`_Callback(...)`) and carries real profile fields (uin, nickname, is_famous ...). No x-oidb involved, so the old 4001 never applied here.

feed_identifier_shape.note: A feed's identifiers are NOT at the top level -- that level is entirely cell_* keys (43 of them). They are nested one level down as feed_id (a hex string, e.g. 0cae399cdf11036ba3f80500) and app_id (e.g. 311).
feed_identifier_shape.consequence: Any code that looks for feed.id or feed.tid finds nothing and silently builds a request with an empty id -- which the server answers retcode 0 with empty data rather than an error.

two_transports.trpc_over_http: POST https://h5.qzone.qq.com/http2rpc/gotrpc/v1/{service}/{method}?g_tk=... with Cookie, x-oidb, x-web-qua; bodies and responses are JSON
two_transports.old_cgi: GET https://h5.qzone.qq.com/proxy/domain/<host>/<path>?g_tk=... with Cookie only; responses are JSONP-wrapped and need the wrapper stripped

open_questions: p_skey is unavailable for h5.qzone.qq.com and user.qzone.qq.com (1003). Everything measured works with the qzone.qq.com key.
Request bodies beyond {} are guesses: pagination/search parameters are unverified.
GetComment returned cell_comment null for a feed that may simply have no comments; the correct body shape is unconfirmed.
Publishing, liking and commenting were deliberately not tested -- each needs a real target and would mutate the account. Only DeleteComment was used, aimed at an id that does not exist.
Public qzone routes answer but this account is not whitelisted, so their payload shapes stay unseen.
Old CGI write routes (emotion_cgi_publish_v6, upload) are untested.
No response normalisation exists; everything is raw cell_* / CGI JSON.

product_code_after_this.change: the qzone.* handler no longer claims the endpoint refuses; it says the transport is verified and the builders are not written yet. It was also unreachable before -- the shared group_id check ran first -- and is now exempt by prefix.
product_code_after_this.verify: POST /action {op:'qzone.feeds'} answers 'Qzone is reachable from this client ... but no request builders are implemented yet'.

how_to_recheck: uv run python tools/probe_qzone_auth.py — queues six cases through the live pipe session: the no-x-oidb control, three trpc reads, one write-family reachability call against a synthetic id, and one old CGI read.

implemented.credential_op: qzone.credentials (injected script) -> {uin, pskey, g_tk, available}; the only part that must come from inside QQ

verified_live.get_qzone_profile: ok, 0.7s, real profile from the old CGI
verified_live.comment_qzone: ok, comment id returned and visible on re-read
verified_live.send_qzone_msg: ok, text-only returns tid; with an image the picture lands in cell_media and is readable back
verified_live.delete_qzone_msg: ok, the post disappears from the listing
verified_live.set_qzone_msg_right: ok for ugc_right=1, but the call rewrites the whole post: it needs the current text ('con') or the server answers code -10005 '您未输入内容'. ugc_right=64 (仅自己可见) is refused with code -10083 '使用人数过多，请稍后再试' on every attempt, so that value is unverified rather than broken on our side.

unverified: set_qzone_profile / set_qzone_ban: implemented, not exercised -- they change account state
ugc_right 64/128 on set_qzone_msg_right: refused by the server (-10083), see verified_live
the 12 public-qzone actions: implemented on the same gateway, unverifiable while the account is outside the whitelist
get_qzone_share_ark: needs the Ark API, not implemented

shapes_that_were_guessed_wrong_first.note: Every one of these produced a silently empty field rather than an error, so they are pinned in tests/test_qzone_client.py.
shapes_that_were_guessed_wrong_first.author: cell_user_info.user.uin / .nick  (not cell_user_info.uin)
shapes_that_were_guessed_wrong_first.content: cell_summary.summary[].content, a list of rich segments to join (not a string)
shapes_that_were_guessed_wrong_first.comment: id / user.nick / content as a list of segments
shapes_that_were_guessed_wrong_first.write_handle: writes and detail take feed_ref {union_id, cell_feed_transfer, like_key}, never a bare tid -- GetFeedDetail answers retcode 10023 for one

transports_confirmed.cgi_write_root: https://user.qzone.qq.com/proxy/domain/  (publish/delete/set_*); the publish CGI answers 403 on the h5 root
transports_confirmed.upload_without_skey: works -- the session exposes no skey getter, and the upload took p_skey alone
transports_confirmed.publish_tid: at the top level of the answer; `data` is null
